text: Suppose a $2\times2$ matrix $A$ has columns $\vvec_1$ and $\vvec_2$. If the pair of vectors is positively oriented, then the determinant of $A$, denoted $\det(A)$, is the area of the parallelogram formed by $\vvec_1$ and $\vvec_2$. If the pair is negatively oriented, then $\det(A)$ is -1 times the area of the parallelogram.
